PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

3. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Waves? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Waves.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Waves.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Waves.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Waves.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy, Work, Power and Machines? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy, Work, Power and Machines.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pressure? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pressure.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Pressure.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pressure.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pressure.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Physics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Physics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Physics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Physics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Physics.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mechanical Properties of Materials? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mechanical Properties of Materials.

14. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 of 62 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Space Physics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Physics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Pressure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Mechanical Properties of Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Temperature and Thermal Expansion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
